# Harmony Additives Private Limited

> Mumbai-based manufacturer and exporter of specialty chemical additives since 1996. ISO 9001 & 14001 certified. 173 APEO-free products across 6 categories, serving 10+ industries in India and exported to 13 countries.

## About

- Founded: 1996 (30 years in specialty chemicals)
- Headquarters: Gorai-1, Borivali (West), Mumbai 400 092, Maharashtra, India
- Manufacturing: 3 facilities — two in Tarapur (Maharashtra) and one in Umbergaon (Gujarat)
- Certifications: ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO 14001 (Environment)
- All products are APEO-free (no alkylphenol ethoxylates)
- Contact: +91 98207 80452 · sales@additive.in · export@additive.in

## Product Categories

- [Defoamers & Antifoams](https://harmonyadditive.in/products/defoamers/): 70 silicone, mineral-oil & polyether foam-control agents for aqueous and non-aqueous systems.
- [Wetting & Dispersing Agents](https://harmonyadditive.in/products/wetting-dispersing-agents/): 28 dispersants for organic and inorganic pigment systems, including dedicated carbon black and titanium dioxide grades.
- [Emulsifiers](https://harmonyadditive.in/products/emulsifiers/): 15 anionic, non-ionic, cationic & biodegradable emulsifiers for agrochemicals, paints and metalworking fluids.
- [Thickeners & Anti-Settling Agents](https://harmonyadditive.in/products/thickeners-anti-settling-agents/): 27 cellulosic, HASE acrylic, HEUR polyurethane and powder rheology modifiers for coatings, inks and detergents.
- [Surface Property Enhancers](https://harmonyadditive.in/products/surface-property-enhancers/): 11 silicone leveling agents and PE wax dispersions for slip, gloss and mar-scratch resistance.
- [Specialty & Tailor-Made Additives](https://harmonyadditive.in/products/specialty-tailor-made/): 22 water repellents, optical brighteners, anti-skinning agents, ETP flocculants, plus custom formulation development.
